record.bible_text: Then Job<WH0347> answered<WH06030><WTH8799> and said<WH0559><WTH8799>,
I have heard<WH08085><WTH8804> many such things<WH07227>: miserable<WH05999> comforters<WH05162><WTH8764> <FI>are<Fi> ye all. <RF>miserable: or, troublesome<Rf>
Shall vain<WH07307> words<WH01697> have an end<WH07093>? or what emboldeneth<WH04834><WTH8686> thee that thou answerest<WH06030><WTH8799>? <RF>vain...: Heb. words of wind<Rf>

I also could speak<WH01696><WTH8762> as ye <FI>do<Fi> : if<WH03863> your soul<WH05315> were<WH03426> in my soul's<WH05315> stead, I could heap up<WH02266><WTH8686> words<WH04405> against you, and shake<WH05128><WTH8686> mine head<WH07218> at<WH01119> you.
<FI> But<Fi> I would strengthen<WH0553><WTH8762> you with<WH01119> my mouth<WH06310>, and the moving<WH05205> of my lips<WH08193> should asswage<WH02820><WTH8799> <FI>your grief<Fi> .<CM>

Though I speak<WH01696><WTH8762>, my grief<WH03511> is not asswaged<WH02820><WTH8735>: and <FI>though<Fi> I forbear<WH02308><WTH8799>, what am I eased<WH01980><WTH8799>? <RF>what...: Heb. what goeth from me?<Rf>
But now he hath made me weary<WH03811><WTH8689>: thou hast made desolate<WH08074><WTH8689> all my company<WH05712>.

And thou hast filled me with wrinkles<WH07059><WTH8799>, <FI>which<Fi> is a witness<WH05707> <FI>against me<Fi> : and my leanness<WH03585> rising up<WH06965><WTH8799> in me beareth witness<WH06030><WTH8799> to my face<WH06440>.

He teareth<WH02963><WTH8804> <FI>me<Fi> in his wrath<WH0639>, who hateth<WH07852><WTH8799> me: he gnasheth<WH02786><WTH8804> upon me with his teeth<WH08127>; mine enemy<WH06862> sharpeneth<WH03913><WTH8799> his eyes<WH05869> upon me.

They have gaped<WH06473><WTH8804> upon me with their mouth<WH06310>; they have smitten<WH05221><WTH8689> me upon the cheek<WH03895> reproachfully<WH02781>; they have gathered<WH04390><WTH8691> themselves together<WH03162> against me.
God<WH0410> hath delivered<WH05462><WTH8686> me to the ungodly<WH05760>, and turned me over<WH03399><WTH8804> into the hands<WH03027> of the wicked<WH07563>. <RF>hath...: Heb. hath shut me up<Rf>

I was at ease<WH07961>, but he hath broken me asunder<WH06565><WTH8770>: he hath also taken<WH0270><WTH8804> <FI>me<Fi> by my neck<WH06203>, and shaken me to pieces<WH06327><WTH8770>, and set me up<WH06965><WTH8686> for his mark<WH04307>.

His archers<WH07228> compass me round about<WH05437><WTH8799>, he cleaveth<WH06398><WH00> my reins<WH03629> asunder<WH06398><WTH8762>, and doth not spare<WH02550><WTH8799>; he poureth out<WH08210><WTH8799> my gall<WH04845> upon the ground<WH0776>.
He breaketh<WH06555><WTH8799> me with breach<WH06556> upon<WH06440> breach<WH06556>, he runneth<WH07323><WTH8799> upon me like a giant<WH01368>.
I have sewed<WH08609><WTH8804> sackcloth<WH08242> upon my skin<WH01539>, and defiled<WH05953><WTH8782> my horn<WH07161> in the dust<WH06083>.
My face<WH06440> is foul<WH02560><WTH8777> with weeping<WH01065>, and on my eyelids<WH06079> <FI>is<Fi> the shadow of death<WH06757>;<CM>
Not for <FI>any<Fi> injustice<WH02555> in mine hands<WH03709>: also my prayer<WH08605> <FI>is<Fi> pure<WH02134>.
O earth<WH0776>, cover<WH03680><WTH8762> not thou my blood<WH01818>, and let my cry<WH02201> have no place<WH04725>.
Also now, behold, my witness<WH05707> <FI>is<Fi> in heaven<WH08064>, and my record<WH07717> <FI>is<Fi> on high<WH04791>. <RF>on high: Heb. in the high places<Rf>
My friends<WH07453> scorn<WH03887><WTH8688> me: <FI>but<Fi> mine eye<WH05869> poureth out<WH01811><WTH8804> <FI>tears<Fi> unto God<WH0433>. <RF>scorn me: Heb. are my scorners<Rf>
O that one might plead<WH03198><WTH8686> for a man<WH01397> with God<WH0433>, as a man<WH0120> <FI>pleadeth<Fi> for his neighbour<WH01121><WH07453>! <RF>neighbour: or, friend<Rf>

When a few<WH04557> years<WH08141> are come<WH0857><WTH8799>, then I shall go<WH01980><WTH8799> the way<WH0734> <FI>whence<Fi> I shall not return<WH07725><WTH8799>. <RF>a few...: Heb. years of number<Rf><CM>
